text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is thrusting practice. Are 
you ready, Falcon-san, Jordan-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First, take the basic stance, then extend 
your arm swiftly along the line beneath 
your feet. And thrust at the target!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"For the stance, heels together, bend 
down...? Align with the line? Uhhh, 
wait~?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Extend your arms, raise your toes, and 
step your front foot half a step forward. 
You don't have to clench your pinky so 
hard. First, your index finger—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? Toes? Fingers? Forelegs!? 
Gaaah, I don't get it! This is too 
haaaard!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to rush. You'll get used 
to it as we repeat the process, so let's 
do our best.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Once you master the basics, you'll improve 
quickly. First, memorize the form, engrave 
it into your body—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, aren't swords just awkward to hold 
in the first place? I'm not used to it, 
and there's too much to do~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right~? If there were just one familiar 
thing, we could build on it from there, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Um, what on earth are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, watch closely, Flash-san! 
Behold Falco's fencing dance☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "I'm on Umatok~♪ Party on!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Get Zero! Aim for the bullseyeâª Take 
that, and thatâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tadaaa—! Perfect score!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! Look, Flash-san, a perfect score!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I got full marks too~!! How's that, 
Fra-san?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why...?! Not only does it lack any 
fundamentals, it isn't even a sword...?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's not what fencing should be... but the 
timing of her thrusts is actually 
perfect...? No, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ba-dum-tadaaa—! Perfect score!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Back-to-back perfect scores! It 
really makes a difference just holding 
something you're used to♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With this, won't I be a good match against 
Flash-san?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, should we just enter the U.A.F. 
like this? We could totally aim higher 
that way!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice~! A mic, a selfie stick, and a 
sword— let's see which one is the 
strongest☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
......Th-This is one race I absolutely 
cannot lose.
